test_keywords_conflict: test that protobuf messages can use Python reserved keywords like class and if as field names
test_message_with_keyword_name: test creating a protobuf message named with a Python keyword like class and setting its int_field
test_nested_message_keyword: test accessing nested protobuf messages named with Python keywords like try inside a class message
test_field_setattr_keyword: test setting and getting protobuf fields named with Python keywords like if and as using setattr and getattr
test_enum_keyword_values: test assigning protobuf enum values named with Python keywords like default else and True to message fields
